implementation.layout_profile: Exact three-layout source inventory; existing proof validates rooted ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary, source fields, reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD identity/backlinks, and staged ASCII/Binary output fields before qualifying the three LAYOUT callback identities.
implementation.viewport_profile: Exact four type-34 callback identities; existing proof validates typed VIEWPORT projection, unique paper-space LAYOUT membership, reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD ownership, emitted record identity/owner and derived DXF groups 68/69.
implementation.ole2frame_profile: Exact AC1021 tablet handle 0x2B80 route; generation-bound immutable model/payload snapshot, matching type-74 raw source callback/frame, fixed model-space output owner, staged OLE fields/payload comparison, and physical readback/failure/retry controls.

validation.result: passed in ASCII and Binary; four VIEWPORT projections and the OLE2FRAME were freshly read back with typed fields, payload and container ownership; a changed OLE payload preserved the destination and did not publish qualifications; correction and retry passed on the same adapter

validation.strict_whole_source_conversion: passed for the exact AC1021 tablet.dwg source profile; this is not broad AC1021 producer qualification

ole2frame_output_proof.immutable_snapshot: generation-bound DRW_Ole2Frame copy, including raw DWG frame and opaque payload; retained estimate includes vector/string payload and map index, with a 64 MiB aggregate cap
ole2frame_output_proof.staged_output_proof: exact type-74 source callback/frame and typed mBlock identity; staged OLE2FRAME record decoded in ENTITIES and checked for remapped handle, owner 0x1F, OLE version/client/corners/type/mode/lock-aspect, declared payload length and byte-identical payload
ole2frame_output_proof.fresh_readback: ASCII and Binary DXF both reimport exactly one model-space OLE2FRAME with owner 0x1F and matching OLE fields/payload
ole2frame_output_proof.failure_retry: changed payload refused atomically in both encodings; destination preserved and qualification count unchanged; restoring the payload succeeds on the same writer
ole2frame_output_proof.independent_peer_membership: LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON lists OLE2FRAME 0x2B80 in the *Model_Space BLOCK_HEADER entity list (BLOCK_RECORD handle 0x1F). It is absent from both paper-space lists. The entity has entmode=2 and no direct ownerhandle; BLOCK_HEADER membership is the owner evidence.
ole2frame_output_proof.local_adapter_mapping: The reader callback places the entity in synthetic dx_data.mBlock (*U0), which is serialized as model space using the fixed model-space BLOCK_RECORD role. A temporary name-based lookup of *U0 returned zero and was an invalid owner probe.
ole2frame_output_proof.disposition: implemented and verified for the exact tablet source profile; do not generalize without additional source evidence
ole2frame_output_proof.note: LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON independently lists 0x2B80 under the model-space BLOCK_HEADER. The adapter binds its synthetic mBlock delivery to the fixed model-space DXF owner; it does not infer ownership from entmode or resolve *U0 as a BLOCK_RECORD table name. The output entity handle is writer-minted and may differ from the source handle.
